            Welcome!
            I am a SSHRC postdoctoral fellow at Université du Québec
            à Montréal (UQAM). My research centers on how elites and
            masses are linked in democratic systems. My work is situated
            at the intersection between migrant integration, civic
            attitudes, party strategies, and democratic governance.
            Currently, I study migrants’ policy preferences and
            political support. My dissertation proposes a new model of
            partisanship that connects party appeals (elite targeting)
            to partisan identity (psychological attachment to a party).
            I actively collaborate with scholars from various
            disciplines, including public administration and
            sociology.
            My work has been featured in International Journal of
            Public Opinion Research and Electoral
            Studies.
